# XML Archive Platform - Copilot Instructions

This is a Next.js application for archiving electronic fiscal documents (NFe, CTe) from the last 10 years.

## Project Overview
- **Framework**: Next.js with TypeScript
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS
- **Purpose**: Digital archive platform for XML documents (NFe, CTe)
- **Features**: Upload, list, search, and monitor storage usage

## Development Guidelines
- Use TypeScript for all components and pages
- Follow Next.js App Router conventions
- Implement responsive design with Tailwind CSS
- Handle XML parsing and validation
- Provide storage monitoring capabilities

## Key Components
- File upload system for XML documents
- Document listing with pagination
- Search functionality
- Storage usage monitoring
- Document metadata extraction and display
